API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITraffic ForwardingIpv6 Config Resource Get NAT64 Prefixes
Ipv6 Config Resource Get NAT64 Prefixes
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/ipv6config/nat64prefix

Gets the list of NAT64 prefixes configured for the organization. The prefix which has the dnsPrefix field set to true is identified as the DNS64 prefix. To learn more, see About NAT64 Prefixes.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

The search string used to match against a NAT64 prefix’s name, description, or prefixMask attributes.

page
int32

Specifies the page offset.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 100 and the maximum size is 1000.

Default value: 500
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

A unique identifier for the NAT64 prefix.

name
string

The name of the NAT64 prefix.

description
string

The description of the NAT64 prefix.

prefixMask
string

The subnet mask for the NAT64 prefix.

dnsPrefix
boolean

Indicates whether or not this NAT64 prefix is the DNS64 prefix.

nonEditable
boolean

Indicates whether or not this NAT64 prefix is editable.

]
